business_summary: Beijing Jingwei Hirain Technologies Co., Inc. engages in research, development, production, and sale of automotive electronic products and services in China. It offers advanced driver assistance system, ADAS domain control unit, auto parking assist system, high-performance computing, 4D millimeter wave radar, location and HD-MAP unit, driver monitoring system, high-performance automotive-grade LiDAR, and 4D imaging radar; intelligent networking electronics, such as remote communication and gateway controller; body and comfort electronics, including anti- pinch control unit, body control module, passive entry passive start system, body domain controller, power lift gate module, door domain control unit, seat control module, central computing platform, zonal control unit, and digital key; and chassis control electronics, such as electric power steering system and parking brake, electric-wired braking system, chassis domain controller, and steer-by-wire. The company also provides vehicle control unit, battery management system, motor control unit, on-board charger, DC-DC on-board power supply, X-in-1 controller, and intelligent actuator unit; vehicle cameras, over heads console, adaptive front lighting system, ambient light system, adaptive driving beam system, AR-HUD, and smart cockpit sensing system; commercial vehicle body and door control module, commercial vehicle body domain control unit and zone, vehicle thermal management system, vehicle power module dcdc, automotive intelligent combination switch, and passive entry and passive start system; and automotive electronics development services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Beijing, China.
